name: naksha-dashboard-setup
expected_output: Explains what Naksha Live records and that it stays local, then enables it by running the bundled script, which writes .naksha/dashboard.json with enabled: true and a .naksha/.gitignore

assertions.name: explains-before-enabling
assertions.description: tells the user what will be recorded (command names, subagents/roles, tool counts) before running anything

assertions.name: privacy-stated
assertions.description: states that prompt text is never stored and that nothing leaves the machine

assertions.name: runs-setup-script
assertions.description: runs node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dashboard/server.js" setup with the path quoted

assertions.name: writes-dashboard-json
assertions.description: results in .naksha/dashboard.json containing "enabled": true (direct write, not a naksha-memory-update block)

assertions.name: no-auto-start
assertions.description: does not start the server during setup; points to /naksha-dashboard start instead

name: naksha-dashboard-start-url
prompt: /naksha-dashboard start (dashboard enabled in .naksha/dashboard.json, server not running)
expected_output: Starts the zero-dependency server in the background and gives the user the exact tokenized 127.0.0.1 URL

assertions.name: runs-start
assertions.description: runs the bundled server.js start subcommand (no npm install, no Express)

assertions.name: prints-tokenized-url
assertions.description: shows a URL on 127.0.0.1 that includes ?token=

assertions.name: token-rotates
assertions.description: mentions the token changes on each start and that /naksha-dashboard status shows the current URL

assertions.name: local-only
assertions.description: states the dashboard is local-only (bound to 127.0.0.1)

name: naksha-dashboard-not-enabled
expected_output: Does not enable anything implicitly; explains Live is not set up and offers /naksha-dashboard setup

assertions.name: no-implicit-enable
assertions.description: does not write .naksha/dashboard.json or enable hooks without the user running setup

assertions.name: non-nagging
assertions.description: keeps the suggestion to one or two sentences

name: naksha-dashboard-disable
expected_output: Stops the server, sets enabled: false so hooks become no-ops, keeps the event history and says how to delete it

assertions.name: runs-disable
assertions.description: runs the bundled server.js disable subcommand

assertions.name: hooks-noop
assertions.description: explains that hooks are now no-ops

assertions.name: history-kept
assertions.description: says .naksha/events.jsonl is kept and can be deleted to remove history

assertions.name: server-stopped
assertions.description: confirms the running server was stopped
